events.detail: Remote HEAD 7fc84889f28670fd6386965963d029e19cbbd0cf, checkpoint sequence 35, queued status and absent Automation 167 truth were re-read.
Current SDL and Auction House first-party pages were scanned in parallel for twelve land, garage, office and development records.
Ten selected titles were searched against the repository before write and no prior candidate rows were returned.
Both freehold land rows were stored as development potential subject to planning or consents, not as permission.
Plot 9 was recorded as allocated public open space; the allocation was preserved as a constraint rather than development entitlement.
The 2.98-hectare land row preserves the TPO, unadopted access and development overage without inferring permission.
House drawings were retained as feasibility only because both direct pages expressly state no planning application was submitted.
The 771 sqm Hornhill Road plot was recorded as current vacant land with no submitted scheme or permission stated.
F/YR21/1448/O was recorded as outline permission for up to four dwellings with all matters reserved; current validity and conditions remain pending.
GBP 63,444.84 current rent, GBP 73,500 ERV and consent-dependent conversion drawings were separated; ERV was not treated as current income.
The sixteen-garage site was recorded with ongoing-use and redevelopment potential only subject to planning.
Peach Tree Farm and Newton Street were excluded from the current-open count because their direct pages mark re-entry to a future auction.
Ten unique research candidates and ten first-party source upgrades were prepared with no promotion and no duplicate rewrite.
The canonical row page was extended through wave 31 so the ten new candidates and two exclusions render line by line.
Wave 31 data, web, report, progress, status and checkpoint artifacts were prepared with all safety flags preserved.
Automation 167 still requires pickup by the existing canonical shared runner and a real port-8012 headless-browser DOM readback.
